benchmarks.name: balanis-ex14-edge-probe

benchmarks.name: sheen1990-branch-line-coupler
benchmarks.source: D. M. Sheen, S. M. Ali, M. D. Abouzahra, J. A. Kong, IEEE Trans. MTT 38(7), 1990, pp. 849-857, measured and FDTD: line-fed patch (Figs. 3, 5, 6), low-pass filter (Figs. 7, 9, 10), branch-line coupler (Figs. 11, 13)

comparisons.note: Sheen gives the operating point as about 6.5 GHz in both calculation and measurement (text). NobuRF |S31| = -3.24 dB and |S41| = -3.22 dB there; ideal -3.01 dB
NobuRF -20.2 dB. Sheen: the S11 and S21 nulls sit at the operating point (text). The lumped ports are not de-embedded, so their own reflection adds to S11 and can move a deep null
NobuRF -18.2 dB. Port 2 is the isolated port: it sits across the narrow branch from port 1

benchmarks.name: pozar-ex3.7-z0
benchmarks.source: D. M. Pozar, Microwave Engineering, 4th ed., 2012, Example 3.7 (pp. 149-150), with Hammerstad-Jensen 1980 and Kirschning-Jansen 1982

comparisons.quantity: Re(Z0), mean over 8-12 GHz, lossy line (tan d 0.3 at 10 GHz)
comparisons.note: Hammerstad-Jensen at W/h = 1, dispersion by Kirschning-Jansen, loss by Pozar eq. 3.198. Lossless H-J Z0 at this width: 49.05 ohm (Pozar's 50 ohm width is 0.483 mm)

benchmarks.name: pozar-ex3.7-eeff
benchmarks.source: D. M. Pozar, Microwave Engineering, 4th ed., 2012, Example 3.7 (pp. 149-150), with Hammerstad-Jensen 1980 and Kirschning-Jansen 1982

comparisons.note: Resonances 9.294 GHz (n = 1, 5.8 mm) and 9.547 GHz (n = 2, 11.6 mm). Static H-J eps_eff at W/h = 1: 6.642; Pozar's quasi-static value at W = 0.483 mm: 6.665
